description:
**Job Description:**

**About ETS:**  
ETS is a global education and talent solutions organization enabling lifelong learners worldwide to be future-ready. For more than 75 years, we've been advancing the science of measurement to build benchmarks for fair and valid skill assessment across cultures and borders. Our worldwide impact extends through our renowned assessments including TOEFL®, TOEIC®, GRE® and Praxis® tests, serving millions of learners in more than 200 countries and territories. Through strategic acquisitions, we've expanded our global capabilities: PSI strengthens our workforce assessment solutions, while Edusoft, Kira Talent, Pipplet, Vericant, and Wheebox enhance our educational technology and assessment platforms across critical markets worldwide.

Through ETS Research Institute and ETS Solutions, we're partnering with educational institutions, governments, and organizations globally to promote skill proficiency, empower upward mobility, and unlock opportunities for everyone, everywhere. With offices and partners across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas, we deliver nearly 50 million tests annually. Join us in our journey of measuring progress to power human progress worldwide.

The Compensation Analyst supports the design, administration, and evaluation of compensation programs that attract, retain and engage employees across the enterprise. The role ensures data integrity and compliance, and partners with HR and operational leaders to deliver total rewards programs and solutions that align with ETS's organizational priorities. The role will be heavily focused on compensation (70-80%), with some supporting employee benefits-related initiatives and processes.

* Conduct job evaluations and market pricing; analyze survey data to recommend salary ranges, structures, and pay positioning by role, level, and location.

* Ensure adherence to compensation policies, pay governance, and regulatory requirements; maintain audit trails and documentation.
* Participate in salary surveys and manage compensation database vendors.
* Provide excellent service support to internal customers (HR, leaders & employees).
* Maintain accurate Rewards data in both internal HRIS system and external vendor systems.
* Support the global benefits team with Indian benefits administration as needed.

  
**Experience and Skills:**

**KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS**

* Clear communicator able to translate methodology into practical guidance for managers and employees; commitment to transparency and equity.
* Solid understanding of compensation fundamentals, including job/level matching, market pricing, program design
* Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, AI (Copilot) and other tools
* Ability to effectively analyze, interpret data and create meaningful, understandable models, reports, metrics, and recommendations
* Excellent attention to detail & ownership
* Strong sense of urgency with the ability to handle multiple competing priorities.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelors' Degree, in a related field
* 2-3 years of core compensation experience with hands-on market pricing, job evaluation, and annual planning; US compensation exposure preferred.

description:

Reporting to the Global L&D Strategy & Transformation Senior Director, you will run a ringfenced innovation team focused on identifying, prototyping, and PoC testing the next generation of online learning experiences for BCG.

BCG's L&D model is evolving to deliver faster, more personalized, data-informed, and AI-enabled upskilling in support of BCG's 2030 strategy. You will be a critical leader in making that roadmap real, helping stand up the innovation team and tech squad, pilot adaptive learning, develop agentic learning prototypes to scale new products and experiences over time.

You will lead work across three connected domains:

* Innovation portfolio management - shaping the intake, prioritization, sequencing, governance, and delivery discipline for a portfolio of high-priority L&D innovation initiatives
* Experimentation and product development - leading the development and validation of new audience-facing learning experiences, products, formats, and AI-enabled solutions
* Implementation and scaling - partnering across L&D, Talent, IT/Product, and business stakeholders to move successful pilots into durable products, programs, platforms, or operating routines

The work will include experimentation with AI tools, AI workflows and automation for L&D internal transformation, and prototyping and piloting of agentic and adaptive learning experiences aligned to the 2030 L&D strategy. You will help BCG shift from slower, programmatic learning cycles toward rapid upskilling in short cycles - weeks, not years - particularly for emerging business needs and technical skills.

What You'll Bring

* 10+ years of experience in innovation, product management, digital transformation, learning transformation, talent/capability building, strategy execution, or enterprise program leadership
* Experience leading teams in complex, global, matrixed environments, with a strong track record of coaching, developing, and mobilizing talent
* Demonstrated ability to move work from ideation through design, build, pilot and value proof.
* Experience in designing innovation with scale in mind, anticipating the technical, integration, and operating requirements needed to move successful pilots into production and enable a smooth handover to Product and IT
* Curiosity and the desire to change the status quo.
* Strong technology literacy, including comfort working with AI-enabled tools, digital products, workflow automation, learning platforms, or data-enabled solutions
* Experience managing a portfolio of initiatives with competing priorities, limited resources, and senior stakeholder visibility
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders, align cross-functional partners, and manage tradeoffs with sound judgment
* Experience working with agile, product-led, design-thinking, test-and-learn, or rapid prototyping approaches
* Strong problem-solving and structured thinking, with the ability to bring clarity to ambiguous or fast-changing topics
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to translate technical or conceptual ideas into clear business and learning implications
* Comfort operating at both strategic and executional levels - you can set direction and personally help get the work done
* Experience in L&D, talent, capability building, HR transformation, or professional services is preferred, but not required for candidates with strong innovation, product, or transformation experience
* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred

Who You'll Work With

You will report to the Global L&D Strategy & Transformation Senior Director and lead the innovation team within the Global L&D Strategy & Transformation Office.

Your direct leadership scope will include the ringfenced innovation team responsible for developing and validating new learning experiences, products, formats, AI-enabled workflows, and agentic/adaptive prototypes. This team will act as a rapid experimentation and delivery capability for the L&D organization, helping relieve pressure from teams managing structured curricula and foundational programs while responding to accelerating demand for digital and AI upskilling.

You will work closely with:

* L&D Strategy Implementation & Transformation to align innovation priorities with the broader 2030 L&D roadmap, governance, investment choices, and transformation milestones
* Rapid AI Adoption teams to connect innovation efforts with urgent business-critical skill needs, AI upskilling priorities, and emerging technical capability requirements
* L&D Business Partners to understand demand from BCG's cohorts, businesses, regions, and functions and translate that demand into prioritized innovation opportunities
* Learning Architecture and Curriculum teams to ensure successful pilots can be embedded into learning journeys and sustained beyond the innovation team
* Learning Product and Operations teams to transition proven solutions into scalable delivery models, platforms, processes, and operating routines
* IT, Product, Data, and AI teams to ensure prototypes and pilots are technically feasible, well-integrated, secure, and aligned with BCG's broader technology ecosystem
* HR, Talent, and People Strategy teams to connect learning innovation to broader skill, performance, talent, and workforce priorities
* Vendors and external partners where third-party platforms, content, tools, or technical capabilities can accelerate delivery

Together, you will help BCG build a faster, more adaptive, more technology-enabled learning ecosystem - one that strengthens our world-class apprenticeship and faculty-led learning while creating scalable, personalized, data-informed learning experiences for the future.

Additional info

**YOU'RE GOOD AT-**

* Taking ideas from concept to implementation - You can start with an ambiguous business or learning need, shape the problem, define the opportunity, mobilize the right people, test a technical solution, and evaluate what is needed to drive adoption and scale.
* Running a high-quality innovation portfolio - You bring structure to fast-moving work. You can manage intake, prioritization, resourcing, stage gates, decision rights, dependencies, risks, and handoffs without slowing the team down.
* Leading agile, multidisciplinary teams - You know how to lead teams that may include a mix of learning designers, product owners, technologists, data and analytics colleagues, AI specialists, vendors, and business SMEs. You create clarity, energy, accountability, and momentum.
* Applying technology and AI pragmatically - You are tech literate and curious. You do not need to be an engineer, but you can engage credibly with technical teams, understand what AI and digital tools can and cannot do, and translate emerging capabilities into usable learning solutions.
* Building solutions that are learner-centered and business-backed - You can connect business goals to skill needs, translate those needs into learning experiences, and keep outcomes at the center of the work.
* Collaborating across a complex ecosystem - You can operate in a global, matrixed environment and build strong partnerships with L&D Business Partners, Learning Architecture, Product and Operations, Talent, HR, IT, Product, and senior business stakeholders.
* Managing stakeholders with confidence and judgment - You know how to shape demand, negotiate tradeoffs, communicate progress, surface decisions, and keep stakeholders aligned across seniority levels and functions.
* Experimenting with discipline - You are comfortable with rapid prototyping, piloting, feedback loops, and iteration, but you also know when to stop, pivot, scale, or hand off.
* Leading people through ambiguity and change - You build trust, coach teams, manage performance, and help people do excellent work in a space where priorities, tools, and expectations are evolving quickly.
* Translating innovation into adoption - You understand that a successful prototype is only valuable if it is used. You think ahead about change management, communications, enablement, measurement, and integration into existing workflows.

At Philips, meaningful careers are built by stepping into opportunities that challenge you, broaden your perspective, and enable you to make an impact with care.

As a Rewards Services Partner, you will join us at an important stage in our journey. You will help shape how the team works, contribute across disciplines, and grow your expertise beyond a single Rewards specialization.


**In this role, you have the opportunity to..**

Help build the future of Rewards Services at Philips. This is intentionally a diverse and evolving role. The Central Rewards Services team is new, and not every responsibility or way of working has been fully defined. You will have the space to bring ideas, test better approaches, and take ownership where your experience, curiosity, and energy can create value.


You will work with specialists across the global Rewards landscape, learn from different disciplines, and help connect activities that have traditionally been managed separately. In doing so, you will strengthen both the employee experience and the consistency and effectiveness of our Rewards services.


The role is an opportunity to broaden your career as a Rewards professional while making a visible contribution to the success of a new global team.


**Your role**

* Own and coordinate Global Mobility activities for the APAC region, providing clear guidance and a consistent experience for employees and stakeholders.

* Take ownership beyond established boundaries when new priorities emerge, balancing flexibility with sound judgment and reliable delivery.

**The impact you can make**

Your contribution will go beyond delivering individual processes. You will help turn a newly established team into a connected and trusted global partner by:


* Ensuring a consistent, employee\-focused Global Mobility experience across the APAC region.
* Helping global Rewards processes run smoothly and deliver reliable outcomes.
* Connecting expertise and activities across Central Rewards Services so that work is performed where it creates the most value.
* Bringing forward practical ideas and turning them into improvements that can be scaled globally.
* Helping build a team culture based on collaboration, curiosity, accountability, and continuous learning.

* Analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to turn data and complexity into clear insights and practical actions.

* The ability to organize priorities, deliver reliably, and adapt when business needs change.
* A continuous\-improvement mindset and the confidence to question existing approaches constructively.
* Curiosity, creativity, and flexibility, together with a willingness to step outside your comfort zone.
* The judgment and discretion required when working with confidential employee and business information.
* AI literacy and an interest in using technology to improve how Rewards services are delivered.

**You will thrive in this role if you...**

* Are energized by the opportunity to help create, not only to maintain.
* Can bring structure to ambiguity without waiting for every detail to be defined.
* See change as an opportunity to learn, contribute, and improve.
* Enjoy moving between regional delivery, global processes, analysis, and project work.
* Build trust through collaboration, openness, and follow\-through.
* Want to broaden your Rewards expertise and help a new team become a success.

**How we work together**  

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office\-based teams, this means working in\-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full\-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

Within the Talent Acquisition Product Team, the Candidate Selection squad supports the products and capabilities that underpin how BCG assesses and selects candidates.

  

As a Senior Product Analyst, you will work closely with the Product Owner, business teams, technology teams, QA, and external vendors to shape effective product solutions. You will independently explore business needs, challenge assumptions, and translate complex requirements into clear, actionable solutions, with the Product Owner providing direction and final sign\-off where appropriate.

* Contribute to cross\-functional initiatives and broader Talent Acquisition Product Team priorities as opportunities and business needs evolve.

What You'll Bring

* Experience eliciting, translating, and documenting business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional requirements, and use cases.

* Experience partnering with QA teams to define test scenarios, validate system behaviour, investigate issues, and manage feedback through delivery.

Who You'll Work With
